summary: Tested Phase-based milestone system improvements: SelectItem bug fix, Gantt chart UI overhaul with wave headers and milestone diamonds, and marker milestone support. All backend tests passed (9/9). Frontend UI tests verified all features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test milestones created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-based milestone system with marker support fully working. Key features: 1) SelectItem bug fixed - uses '__none__' value for empty phase selection, 2) Gantt chart shows wave headers (WAVE1 SF, WAVE 2) with visual separation, milestone diamonds on phase bars with labels, unlinked milestones in separate row, 3) Marker milestones (milestone_type='marker') have blue diamonds (#3B82F6) vs amber (#F59E0B) for payment milestones, 4) PaymentMilestones page has separate tables for payment vs marker milestones, 5) WaveContent inline editor has '+ Payment' and '+ Marker' buttons per phase.

selectitem_bug_fix.details: PaymentMilestones page loads without 'Select.Item must have a value' error. Uses '__none__' value for empty phase selection.

gantt_wave_headers.details: Wave headers 'WAVE1 SF' and 'WAVE 2' visible with uppercase bold text and visual separation (border-t)

gantt_milestone_diamonds.details: Milestone diamonds with name labels appear on phase bars. Unlinked milestones (no phase_name) render in separate 'Unlinked' row.

gantt_no_summary_row.details: No separate 'Milestones summary row' at bottom - replaced by inline rendering on phase bars

marker_milestone_wavecontent.details: Phase Ranges section has '+ Payment' and '+ Marker' buttons per phase. Marker milestones show blue diamond icon and NO payment % field.

marker_milestone_payment_page.details: PaymentMilestones page has 'Payment Milestone' (amber) and 'Marker Milestone' (blue) buttons per wave. Marker milestones appear in separate 'Marker Milestones' table without payment fields.

gantt_marker_color.details: Marker milestones render as BLUE diamonds (fill=#3B82F6), payment milestones as AMBER (fill=#F59E0B). Legend shows both types.

bidirectional_sync.details: Milestones added from WaveContent inline editor appear on PaymentMilestones page and vice versa via shared /api/projects/{id}/milestones endpoint.

backend_api_marker.details: PUT /api/projects/{id}/milestones with milestone_type='marker' persists correctly. GET returns milestone_type field.

wave_header_separation.details: Wave2 section in Gantt chart has its own header row and is visually separated from Wave1 SF with border-t border-gray-200
